en: Old monochrome industrial-view postcard showing a factory complex with tall chimneys and adjoining buildings, bordered by bare trees and a dirt road. The front bears Hungarian printed captions in red and purple, plus handwritten ink notes. The reverse has the word "LEVELEZŐLAP" (postcard in Hungarian), handwritten Hungarian text, a Hungarian postage stamp, and postmarks.
